startupNormalization.note: Logical JSON byte length of returned references; memory host performs no JSON/SQLite decoding. Calculated outside measured phases.

audit.note: Logical JSON byte length of returned references; memory host performs no JSON/SQLite decoding. Calculated outside measured phases.

limits: Full methods use recording memory host and sink. No SQLite, capture, network, model, complete task resume or end-to-end run is measured.
Only the recorded path and position are restored to task-before. Other live preaudit state is not reconstructed.
Same explicit empty completed set as the original oracle; all recorded 204 pending candidates and 206 actions remain.
JSON bytes are logical serialization, not physical storage or bytes actually read from a database.
The retained fixture has its original unknown debt only; no synthetic unknown scenarios are added.
Fresh process first-call measurements include each version actual initialization/JIT behavior; they are not warmed steady-state measurements.
